snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Xbox Release Date Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is a single player auto-shooter where you need to survive hordes of aliens and try to strike it rich at the same time. Deep rock Galactic: Survivor comes to Xbox Game Pass, Series X/S, Xbox Cloud, Xbox on PC, and Steam on Sept. 17. 

This video was originally produced by Xbox @ gamescom 2025: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P45cJ2HdFh4
